title: The log analyser
hints: Build it bottom-up. Make `Method` a literal union, then write `statusClass` (four `if`s), then `parseRequest` (one anchored regex with five capture groups), and only then `analyse`, which calls `parseRequest` on each trimmed line.

Regex: `/^(\d\d:\d\d:\d\d) (GET|POST|PUT|DELETE) (\/\S*) ([2-5]\d\d) (\d+)ms$/`. In `analyse`, loop with `text.split("\n").entries()` so you have the index for line numbers. Keep a running total of `ms`, a `Set` of paths, a `Record` with all four status classes at 0, and a `[path, ms] | null` for the slowest, replacing it only when `req.ms > slowest[1]`.

for (const [i, raw] of text.split("\n").entries()) { const line = raw.trim(); if (line === "") continue; const req = parseRequest(line); if (!req) { unreadable.push(i + 1); continue; } if (ignored.has(req.path)) continue; requests++; totalMs += req.ms; paths.add(req.path); byStatus[statusClass(req.status)]++; if (slowest === null || req.ms > slowest[1]) slowest = [req.path, req.ms]; }  then averageMs = requests === 0 ? "n/a" : (totalMs / requests).toFixed(1)
